purpose: Test a small genuinely learned conditional personnel partition family using continuous same-corner replacement geometry; retain failures and unfavorable results.
fusion_policy: No score/fusion/N1 change. Existing actual endpoints first; frozen historical requests may be reconstructed if caches absent.
input_tiers: primary: legacy exact-background plus H20 metadata-selected history anchors, if rebuilt
legacy-only: explicitly reduced-support interim/sensitivity, never silently called full mixed history
domains: primary ordinary Manual both entrants new-source, fixed background may include other source
history_split: Existing frozen ten buildings only; same hash-defined five two-building held-out inner folds as learn_swap_types.make_inner_folds.
distance: 0.5 * (BEV corresponding-corner mean pair-area-normalized distance + top corresponding-corner mean pair-area-normalized distance), unique bound cyclic correspondence candidates only
same_corner_qualification: Complete outputs, same final corner count, finite valid geometry, same pool/image/reference/version. Missing, mismatch, ambiguity and projection failures remain unavailable distances, never zero.
fit_angle_policy: Primary fits use all unique candidates; restricted-angle outcomes are sensitivity only, not extra searched model families.
risk_aggregation: Within each person-pair/building/pool/n average conditional distance for mean and compute observed-distance p90 for tail; equal n within image, equal images within building, equal buildings within pair.
risk_transform: For each training fold, s=median supported-pair mean distance (positive floor 1e-8); mean risk d/(d+s), tail risk t/(t+s). mean_plus_tail uses equal average of transformed mean and tail. Shrink supported risks by one equivalent building toward training supported-pair risk mean. Unknown pair has zero weight.
optimizer: Reuse inspected spectral_init and optimize_partition: known-pair weighted within-risk mean + .03 sum squared class fractions; fixed seed 2026102011, spectral and balanced-shuffled starts, max300 improving single-person moves, no outcome-driven extra restarts.
inner_evaluation: Frozen fold labels evaluated on held-out history buildings; exact anchor supports within and between; aggregate background -> n -> image -> building. Report raw conditional distance, p90, between-minus-within gap, valid-distance coverage, same-count rate, incomplete rate, old joint stability separately.
baselines: fold-refitted legacy or mixed R_new2 as source allows; never use full-history R_new2 as leakage-free inner baseline
training-fold Q and T quantile bins at same K where fold features available
40 random label permutations preserving class capacity (source fixed within primary new-only domain)
discovery: All six candidates may be assessed in the existing separate discovery buildings before selecting few useful coarse/fine hypotheses. Fixed R_new2 and frozen Q/T labels are legitimate discovery baselines.
selection: Retain all results; prefer Pareto improvement of lower within continuous distance and larger between-minus-within gap with disclosed distance-valid/mismatch coverage and no hidden member loss. Do not force a winner; per-class and worker-removal tails decide scope.
assessment_status: Any use of existing six assessment buildings is reused internal replication, not new independent holdout.
interpretation: Unique cyclic correspondence is not proof of semantic structural identity; continuous metric supplements original structure/IoU/Q evidence. Labels are conditional geometry roles; feature profiles describe rather than relabel. ARI is sensitivity only.
deliverables: member IDs and explicit unknown reasons
coarse/fine recommended use only if supported
